About.title: About
About.blockquote: Full-stack developer, CTO & Tech Lead Master's student at HETIC.
About.p1: I build web apps end to end: database, API, interface and deployment. One year as an agency apprentice at Plume, many team projects at HETIC and first place at the HETIC × Publicis hackathon.
About.p2: On the side, I build my own tools and use them with friends and family: a web and mobile strength-training tracker, an anime and manga catalogue, a running tracker.
About.formation: HETIC Web Developer Bachelor (2023–2026) · HETIC CTO & Tech Lead Master's (2026–2028)
About.recherche: web or mobile development apprenticeship · 2 years
About.dispo: now · 3 weeks at work / 1 week at school
